## Notice on the Use of Images and Copyright

This website is committed to respecting intellectual property rights and complying with copyright laws. All images displayed on this website belong to one of the following categories:

### Free License Images

Most of the images used on this website come from repositories that offer content under free licenses, including but not limited to:

- **Creative Commons Licenses** (CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA)
- Materials of **Public Domain**
- Open source image repositories
- Photography platforms **free of royalties**

We do our best to verify that the images are properly licensed for use and, when necessary, provide appropriate attribution to the original creators.

### AI Generated Content

Some images presented on this website have been generated using artificial intelligence tools. These AI generated images are created specifically for this site and do not infringe any copyrighted material.

### Copyright Compliance

While we exercise due diligence to ensure that all visual content complies with applicable copyright laws and license terms, we recognize that inadvertent errors may occur. **If any image displayed on this website inadvertently infringes copyright or intellectual property rights, such use is completely inadvertent and without any malicious purpose.**

### Report Copyright Issues

If you believe that any image on this website violates your copyright or intellectual property rights, please contact us immediately. We are committed to addressing any legitimate concerns promptly and:

1. We will investigate the matter thoroughly
2. We will remove or replace the disputed content if necessary
3. We will provide appropriate attribution if required
4. We will take corrective measures to prevent future occurrences

We value the rights of content creators and are dedicated to maintaining a respectful and legally compliant online presence.
